name: Node-RED Open-Source Flow Automation
free_limit: Apache-2.0 flow-based event and webhook automation runtime with HTTP/MQTT nodes and visual editor; unlimited self-managed flows subject to your own resources.
watch_out: Self-host with Node.js or Docker and secure the editor and endpoints; server, storage and third-party API costs are separate. Community nodes may have different licenses; hosted FlowFuse is a separate offering.
